description:
List your invoices

Returns the invoices raised against the account, newest first. Without paging the body is a bare JSON array rather than a `{ data: [...] }` envelope, and the whole history comes back on each call; send `page` or `perPage` and the response becomes `{ data, pagination }` with a real `total`. There is no date filter either way. The list holds both kinds of invoice the account can have: ours, for what it paid us, and those of its reseller, for what it paid a reseller that bills its customers itself. Each row says which in `source`. The two kinds are numbered independently, so pass `source` on to GET /billing/invoices/{id}/pdf. An invoice from a reseller appears once the reseller has issued it; its `pdfUrl` is always null and the document is rendered on demand through that endpoint.

page.description: Page to return. Starts at 1; values below 1 are clamped to 1.

perPage.description: Items per page. Clamped to the range 1 to 100; larger values are reduced to 100.
